name: Buried Shock Glyph
disable: DC 20 Athletics check (trained) to hurl the stone a safe distance before it activates, or DC 21 Thievery check to delicately move the stone without triggering the glyph.

items.name: Electrocution
items.text:
Trigger A creature jostles or views the glyph

---

Effect An electric discharge shocks the triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet, dealing 3d8 electricity damage to anyone in the area (DC 20 basic Reflex save save).

text: A magical glyph unleashes a blast of electricity when handled.
